messages.author: 5670963b5e6c2b8d
messages.subject: Re: Problem loading data sets from aRules into rattle
parts:
Hi Mark,

The code below will get you two CSV files, each in a different market basket format.  I am not sure if rattle will take these, as I am still trying to install rattle on my new Mac...

library(arules) # Load Library
data(Groceries) # Load Dataset

# Convert all 9,835 baskets to a Matrix
myMatrix <- as(Groceries[1:9835], "matrix")

# Convert all 9,835 baskets to a Frame
myFrame <- as(Groceries[1:9835], "data.frame")

# Output Matrix to CSV
write.csv(myMatrix, file = "marketBasketMatrix.csv", row.names = F)

# Output Frame to CSV
write.csv(myFrame, file = "marketBasketFrame.csv", row.names = F)

Best Regards,
